topic: Calling Roadside Assistance after a Flat Tire

script.title: FLAT ON THE HIGHWAY
script.scene_zh: 公路路肩 · 電話求援
script.story_hook: One flat tire, one dark road, one calm voice.
script.intro_zh: 一個爆胎、一條昏暗的路，一通帶著冷靜聲音的電話。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to a nervous call from the road. Listen for location and safety phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到這通來自公路的緊張電話。留意報位置與保安全的說法。
script.outro: And that's a flat tire with a happy ending. Listen again and try it out loud.
script.outro_zh: 一次爆胎，有了圓滿的結局。再聽一次，大聲跟著說說看。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: Small world, or big radio tower
script.char_a_description: a small young woman in her late twenties with long black braids, a bright orange safety vest over a denim jacket, running shoes, a phone in one hand, and a slim build
script.char_b_description: a calm man in his forties with greying curly hair and a short grey beard, a headset over both ears, a navy dispatch polo, coffee stains on his collar, and a heavy build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I have a flat tire, um, on the highway.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ hæv ə flæt ˈtaɪɚ ʌm ɑn ðə ˈhaɪˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我的車爆胎了，嗯，在快速道路上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, nobody hurt, you on the shoulder right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ˈnoʊbɑdi hɝt ju ɑn ðə ˈʃoʊldɚ ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好，沒人受傷吧，你現在停在路肩了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, shoulder, hazards on, car fully off the road.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈʃoʊldɚ ˈhɑɹzɚdz ɑn kɑɹ ˈfʊli ɑf ðə ɹoʊd/
dialogue.zh: 是的，在路肩上，警示燈開著，車子完全離開了車道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, that's rule one, well done. Where exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðæts ɹul wʌn wɛl dʌn wɛɹ ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 很好，這是第一守則，做得好。確切地點在哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I think... Route 9 west, near a mile marker?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk ɹut naɪn wɛst nɪɹ ə maɪl ˈmɑɹkɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我想……是 9 號公路西向，旁邊好像有塊里程碑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the green sign, what number does it show?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ɡɹin saɪn wʌt ˈnʌmbɚ dʌz ɪt ʃoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 對，就是綠色那塊牌子，上面顯示幾號？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, forty-one, maybe forty-two, it's dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ˈfɔɹti wʌn ˈmeɪbi ˈfɔɹti tu ɪts dɑɹk/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，四十一，也可能四十二，天很黑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trust the forty-one, close enough for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹʌst ðə ˈfɔɹti wʌn kloʊs ɪˈnʌf fɔɹ ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 就報四十一吧，對我們來說夠近了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also, there's an exit named Cedar nearby.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ ðɛɹz ən ˈɛɡzɪt neɪmd ˈsidɚ ˈnɪɹbaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 還有，附近有個出口叫 Cedar。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, exit seven, that pins your spot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ˈɛɡzɪt ˈsɛvən ðæt pɪnz jɔɹ spɑt/
dialogue.zh: 完美，七號出口，這樣就定位了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, you're quick, my hands were shaking there.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ jʊɹz kwɪk maɪ hænz wɚ ˈʃeɪkɪŋ ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 哇，你動作真快，我剛剛手都在抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Totally normal, trucks pass fast, stay put.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊɾəli ˈnɔɹməl tɹʌks pæs fæst steɪ pʊt/
dialogue.zh: 這很正常，貨車從旁邊飛馳，請留在原位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I stay inside the car or stand back?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ steɪ ɪnˈsaɪd ðə kɑɹ ɔɹ stænd bæk/
dialogue.zh: 我該待在車裡，還是站到後面去？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Inside, doors locked, seatbelt on, wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈsaɪd dɔɹz lɑkt ˈsitˌbɛlt ɑn weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 待在車內，鎖門，繫上安全帶，等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, doing it now, um, it's a weird order.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊkeɪ ˈduɪŋ ɪt naʊ ʌm ɪts ə wɪɹd ˈɔɹdɚ/
dialogue.zh: 好，照做了，嗯，這指令有點怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Weird orders save lives, I hand them all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪɹd ˈɔɹdɚz seɪv laɪvz aɪ hænd ðɛm ɔl deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 怪指令能救命，我整天都在發這些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted. The tire is totally flat, sidewall too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊɾɪd ðə ˈtaɪɚ ɪz ˈtoʊɾəli flæt ˈsaɪdwɔl tu/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。輪胎整個扁了，側壁也裂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then no spare, no driving, right call today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn noʊ spɛɹ noʊ ˈdɹaɪvɪŋ ɹaɪt kɔl təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那就別換備胎也別再開了，今天你電話打對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My dad would have changed it on the roadside.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ dæd wʊd hæv tʃeɪndʒd ɪt ɑn ðə ˈɹoʊdsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 我爸肯定會站路邊自己換胎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your dad gets a gold star, you get safety.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔɹ dæd ɡɛts ə ɡoʊld stɑɹ ju ɡɛt ˈseɪfti/
dialogue.zh: 你爸可以得到一顆金星，而你得到了平安。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, true story, he also drives with hazards off.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ tɹu ˈstɔɹi hi ˈɔlsoʊ dɹaɪvz wɪθ ˈhɑɹzɚdz ɑf/
dialogue.zh: 哈，真的，他開車還從不開警示燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please don't tell him I said this, but good.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz doʊnt tɛl hɪm aɪ sɛd ðɪs bət ɡʊd/
dialogue.zh: 請別跟他說我這樣講，不過你做得對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, when does the truck arrive? A guess helps.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wɛn dʌz ðə tɹʌk əˈɹaɪv ə ɡɛs hɛls/
dialogue.zh: 那，救援車大約幾點到？有個數我好安排。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty minutes, maybe fifty, rain is coming.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔɹti ˈmɪnɪts ˈmeɪbi ˈfɔɹti ɹeɪn ɪz ˈkʌmɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 四十分鐘，也許五十分，雨就要下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty! I have a dog, groceries, and no plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔɹti aɪ hæv ə dɑɡ ˈɡɹoʊsɪz ænd noʊ plæn/
dialogue.zh: 四十！我帶著狗和買好的菜，毫無計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Order matters less when you're safe, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔɹdɚ ˈmæɾɚz lɛs wɛn jʊɹ seɪf ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，人安全的時候，行程沒那麼要緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair, um, do you need my membership code?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ ʌm du ju nid maɪ məmˈbɚʃɪp koʊd/
dialogue.zh: 說得也是。嗯，你需要我的會員碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes please, three letters, then four numbers.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz θɹi ˈlɛɾɚz ðɛn fɔɹ ˈnʌmbɚz/
dialogue.zh: 需要，卡上那三個字母再加四個數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it: W-E-S, then nine one four zero.
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ɪt ˈdʌbəlju i ɛs ðɛn naɪn wʌn fɔɹ ˈzɪɹo/
dialogue.zh: 找到了：W、E、S，接著 9、1、4、0。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: W-E-S, that's me, I'll send myself out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʌbəlju i ɛs ðæts mi aɪl send maɪˈsɛlf aʊt/
dialogue.zh: W-E-S 就是我的名字，這單我派給我自己。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Small world, or big radio tower.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ smɑl wɝld ɔɹ bɪɡ ˈɹeɪdioʊ ˈtaʊɚ/
dialogue.zh: 哈！是世界小，還是電波塔大呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both, friend. Now, tow where, got a shop?
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ fɹɛnd naʊ toʊ wɛɹ ɡɑt ə ʃɑp/
dialogue.zh: 都有。拖去哪裡，你有常去的修車廠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My uncle's shop, twelve miles back east.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈʌŋkəlz ʃɑp twɛlv maɪlz bæk iːst/
dialogue.zh: 我叔叔的修車廠，往東約十二英里。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, he'll meet the truck at the gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn hil mit ðə tɹʌk æt ðə ɡeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 辦好，他會在廠門口等車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, how does he know it's coming today?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt haʊ dʌz hi noʊ ɪts ˈkʌmɪŋ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 等等，他怎麼知道今天會有人來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I call shops we trust, two lines, quick chat.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kɔl ʃɑpz wi tɹʌst tu laɪnz kwɪk tʃæt/
dialogue.zh: 我打給我們信任的修車廠，兩三句就講完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're like an air traffic controller, wow.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹz laɪk ən ɛɹ ˈtɹæfɪk kənˈtɹoʊlɚ waʊ/
dialogue.zh: 你根本是航空管制員，哇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With fewer planes, more flat tires, same stress.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪθ ˈfjuɚ pleɪnz mɔɹ flæt ˈtaɪɚz seɪm stɹɛs/
dialogue.zh: 只是飛機少一點、爆胎多一點，壓力一樣大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay you tonight, or at the shop counter?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ peɪ ju təˈnaɪt ɔɹ æt ðə ʃɑp ˈkaʊntɚ/
dialogue.zh: 今晚我要付錢給你們，還是到修車廠櫃台再付？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Membership covers towing, zero tonight, clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /məmˈbɚʃɪp ˈkʌvɚz ˈtoʊɪŋ ˈzɪɹo təˈnaɪt klɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 會員資格涵蓋拖車，今晚零元，清楚吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Zero? Okay, my heart rate can slow down now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈzɪɹo oʊkeɪ maɪ hɑɹt ɹeɪt kən sloʊ daʊn naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 零元？好，我的心跳現在可以慢下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow it, sip water, put on a podcast maybe.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ ɪt sɪp ˈwɔɾɚ pʊt ɑn ə ˈpɑdkæst ˈmeɪbi/
dialogue.zh: 讓它慢下來，喝口水，打開你的播客。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have one episode saved, a cat mystery.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv wʌn ˈɛpɪsoʊd sævd ə kæt ˈmɪstɹi/
dialogue.zh: 我存了一集沒聽，是貓咪偵探故事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect length, forty minutes, one cat solved.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt lɛŋθ ˈfɔɹti ˈmɪnɪts wʌn kæt sɑlvd/
dialogue.zh: 長度剛剛好，四十分鐘，破一宗貓案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You planned my evening, Wes, thank you truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju plænd maɪ ˈivnɪŋ wɛs θæŋk ju ˈtɹuli/
dialogue.zh: 你把我的夜晚都排好了，Wes，真心感謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the job, code sent, stay visible, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə dʒɑb koʊd sɛnt steɪ ˈvɪzəbl̩ pliz/
dialogue.zh: 這是工作嘛。碼寄好了，請讓外面看得到你，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Visible how? Keep hazards blinking, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɪzəbl̩ haʊ kip ˈhɑɹzɚdz ˈblɪŋkɪŋ ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 怎樣才算明顯？警示燈繼續閃，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, plus turn on your phone light inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs plʌs tɜn ɑn jɔɹ foʊn laɪt ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 對，再把手機螢幕開亮，放在車窗邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. Truck's yellow, I'll know it's you, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn tɹʌks ˈjɛloʊ aɪl noʊ ɪts ju ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好了。救援車是黃色，我會認得你們，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yellow with blue stripe, driver shows ID first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjɛloʊ wɪθ blu staɪp ˈdɹaɪvɚ ʃoʊz ˌaɪˈdi fɝst/
dialogue.zh: 黃色加藍條紋，司機會先向你出示證件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll check like a spy, very serious about it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl tʃɛk laɪk ə spaɪ ˈvɛɹi ˈsɪɹiəs əˈbaʊt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我會像間諜一樣查證，非常認真地查。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, we train drivers for that exact check.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd wi tɹeɪn ˈdɹaɪvɚz fɔɹ ðæt ɪɡˈzækt tʃɛk/
dialogue.zh: 很好，我們訓練司機就是為了這一關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty minutes gone, and the rain just started.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔɹti ˈmɪnɪts ɡɑn ænd ðə ɹeɪn dʒʌst ˈstɑɹɾɪd/
dialogue.zh: 四十分鐘過了，雨剛剛才落了下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right on time, my radio says he's exit seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt ɑn taɪm maɪ ˈɹeɪdioʊ sɛz hɪz ˈɛɡzɪt ˈsɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 準時，我耳機裡說他已下七號出口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see yellow! Oh my goodness, actual miracle.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ˈjɛloʊ oʊ maɪ ˈɡʊdnəs ˈæktʃuəl ˈmɪɹəkəl/
dialogue.zh: 我看到黃色了！天啊，簡直是奇蹟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Miracle's Tuesday regular, welcome to the club.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪɹəkəlz ˈtuzdeɪ ˈɹɛɡjəlɚ wɛlkəm tə ðə klʌb/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，奇蹟只是週二的日常，歡迎入會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He's waving me down, I'm ending the call now.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪz ˈweɪvɪŋ mi daʊn aɪm ˈɛndɪŋ ðə kɔl naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 他在揮手叫我過去，我要掛電話囉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go on, stay inside till he hooks up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ ɑn steɪ ɪnˈsaɪd tɪl hi hʊks ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 去吧，在他掛好車以前，請待在車裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for the calm, Wes, huge thanks.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju fɔɹ ðə kɑm wɛs hjuːdʒ θæŋks/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你帶來的冷靜，Wes，超大感謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You did great. Text us a rating, bye-bye.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju dɪd ɡɹeɪt tɛkst ʌs ə ˈɹeɪɾɪŋ ˈbaɪbaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 你做得很棒。記得傳評分給我們，再見囉。

script.youtube_title: 【高速公路爆胎求援🚗】「世界小還是電波塔大」😲｜60句道路救援電話聽力📞🎧｜聽完就會報位置｜Roadside Assistance Call
script.youtube_title_en: "Small World, or Big Radio Tower" — Calling Roadside Assistance with a Flat
script.youtube_description:
「是世界小，還是電波塔大？」——天黑的高速公路，車胎扁了，雨又要來，那通求助電話你打得出來嗎？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在公路路肩與救援中心的電話兩端。

你會聽到：說明爆胎、確認人安全的開場句；報公路、方向、里程碑與出口的完整位置說法；該待在車裡還是站出去的指令；會員卡上三個字母與四個數字的讀法；四十分鐘等待、拖車去向、司機先出示證件的流程。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人講電話的自然語感：um、okay、oh、ha、wow。聽完你就會用：I have a flat tire、I'm on the shoulder、stay inside the car、do you need my membership code。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Small world, or big radio tower" — your tire went flat on a dark highway, rain is coming, and one phone call stands between you and safety. This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set on the shoulder and at the dispatch desk.

You will hear: saying you have a flat tire and confirming nobody is hurt; giving the route, direction, mile marker and exit; the stay-inside-the-car safety orders; reading a membership code letter by letter; forty-minute wait times, where the tow goes, and drivers showing ID first.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with the phone rhythm Americans use daily: um, okay, oh, ha, wow. By the end you'll own phrases like I'm on the shoulder, do you need my membership code, and when does the truck arrive.

The second half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.
